query: Can you guide me through applying for a Tamil Nadu Police dog handler role?
reference_answer:
Tamil Nadu Police Dog Handler Positions:
To apply, visit the Tamil Nadu Uniformed Services Recruitment Board (TNUSRB) website for notifications. Meet the eligibility criteria, fill out the online application, and appear for the written exam and physical tests.
answer: To apply for a Tamil Nadu Police dog handler role, visit the official Tamil Nadu Police recruitment website. Prepare documents including recent passport-sized photos, educational certificates, and a valid police background check. Conduct physical training and pass a medical examination. Submit your application online or in person at designated centers. [Document 1]
